articles.title: SpaceX's $2.6 trillion market cap nearly double that of bitcoin
articles.snippet: Eight days after its IPO, SpaceX has surged past $2.5 trillion to become the world's sixth-largest company. And market watchers say it is pulling the risk capital crypto wants.

articles.title: BitGo offers Europe’s crypto firms a MiCA-compliance lifeline as license deadline looms
articles.snippet: BaFin-regulated BitGo says its Crypto-as-a-Service platform can help eligible crypto players across Europe with an alternative way to navigate MiCA.

articles.title: BitGo courts crypto firms awaiting MiCA approval amid Binance licensing concerns
articles.snippet: BitGo launches a MiCA-compliant crypto infrastructure platform in Europe as exchanges face pressure to meet July 1 licensing rules across the EU.

articles.title: Illinois governor approves crypto transaction tax despite industry uproar
articles.snippet: “There is effectively no comparable state financial transaction tax on stocks, bonds or derivatives anywhere in the country,” said a16z general counsel Miles Jennings.
